title: Bambu Lab P2S C $1,149 & X2D C $1349 H2S C $2199 & 10% Bonus Gift Card + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: Bambu Lab P2S C $1,149 & X2D C $1349 H2S C $2199 & 10% Bonus Gift Card + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Harvey Norman

[mickeyjuiceman] Gift card has one-month expiry
I'm pretty surprised this is legal
[bluemyself] Agreed.
At least the expiry should be more prominent.
[3dprintdeals] Yep, that's why try and price match at JB as that gift card wont have an expiry.
Plus, more things to buy at JB than at HN
[HardlyNormal] expiry is fair point, but theres no way that JB sell more items than HN
[HardlyNormal] @3dprintdeals: your point of getting a JB gift card because there’s more to buy is completely false
HN stores have whole furniture, bedding, flooring, outdoors depts + our electrical dept has more in it
computers/tech dept is probably the only area where it’s plausible that JB have more to buy
[Ijuiceman] I was not told about this when I bought nearly 5k worth of gear. I now have a $485 expired gift card. I was thinking of trying my luck with HN as they did not tell me about the expiry at the time.
[mickeyjuiceman] Wave the ACCC at them, at least, for sure
[cook99] Yup, I'd be saying you've been misled and mention ACL. Amazing how fast a 'gesture of goodwill' comes out.
[HardlyNormal] stores are usually pretty open about just reactivating the gift cards, have done plenty for customers
[3dprintdeals] They could be normal and offer regular expiry periods like "never expires"
[Franc-T] Mabye but sounds like forcing the customer to a cross-sell
[Black Hole] Oh man, I did not know there is a one month expiry. I have bought an LG OLED TV from them in July and I was not aware there is a 1 month expiry on the Gift until I saw this post. I went to check and it has expired a 3 days ago.
[HardlyNormal] ask the store, they usually are happy to reactivate the gift cards so you buy stuff
[Black Hole] Thank, I will attend the store tomorrow. I am planning to purchase another item at HN tomorrow. Can I ask them nicely to deduct 10% instead of getting the gift card :)?
[HardlyNormal] @Black Hole: they definitely wont be able to deduct the gc off the item, it won’t let us
[bluemyself] Can also get 10% gift cards with the following deal at Big W, which you can then use at JB, Officeworks or Good Guys (and maybe others, I dunno)
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/971974
There's also other deals that give you Everyday or Flybuys points I think if you'd rather have that.
[3dprintdeals] Stack both if you can get JB to pricematch
[3dprintdeals] I dont think they will stock h2c on the shelves
[bluemyself] Officeworks has them (but not in store though). Might be able to use the gift card deal I posted above but they're only $50 denominations. You'd be there all day.
[wattstar] My local HN has one in storage because I joked that he could just give me that one instead if he couldn’t find the X2d I purchased. It’s not on their website though, they were only just setting up a display for bambu products today.
[superroach] The one month gift card thing is outrageous.
[Geoff897] Just saw a Fb Ad,
Bonus Gift Card can be used towards the purchase of:
TVs & Audio, Cooking & Home Appliances, Mobiles & Computers, Mattresses, Furniture, Flooring, Bathroom & much more!
[3dprintdeals] Don't fight. Just resist buying more filament.
[SirFaffer] Agreed… 7 weeks ago I had 10 rolls. Now I have 94. :-/
[SirFaffer] The X2D is definitely worth the extra over the P2S, if for no other reason than being able to use PETG supports with PLA or vice versa is incredible. If you want to do multicolour, however, get the Snapmaker U1.
